title: Rehoboth Bay Marina

services.name: Boat & Jet Ski Slips
services.desc: Rehoboth Bay Marina offers a variety of Boat and Jet Ski Slips, catering to both seasonal and transient users. Our slips are designed for easy access and security, ensuring a hassle-free experience. Each slip benefits from our comprehensive amenities, including running water, a fuel dock, and a ship store. For jet ski enthusiasts, our specialized jet ski slips provide the perfect launch point for quick and easy access to the water. Easily manage your docking needs with the Dockwa app, streamlining your marina

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Escape to a one-of-a-kind waterfront retreat, where modern comfort meets coastal charm. This brand-new two-bedroom houseboat offers an unparalleled stay on the Rehoboth Bay, surrounded by breathtaking views and the serenity of life on the water. Thoughtfully designed with stylish furnishings, a fully stocked kitchen, and inviting living spaces, it provides the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Nestled in the heart of Rehoboth Bay Marina, just moments from the beach and the vibrant energy of Dewey Beach, this unique getaway promises an unforgettable experience.
